subject: Orion Sandbox connector stitch plan + success metrics
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Ahmed Khan <ahmed.khan@orion.ai>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@orion.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Orion sandbox — post-demo recap and connector stitch proposal

Hi Ahmed / Marta,

Great conversation today — thanks for walking us through the sandbox use cases. Per our discussion I captured a lean connector "stitch" plan that lets your team exercise the streaming + tool-calling paths you showed without a full production deploy. High-level:

- Scope: ingest sample chat events (1M tokens/day sim) -> pass through Redwood hosted sandbox model (streaming responses), exercise tool-calls to your internal entity-resolution service (HTTP webhook) and validate latency/throughput envelopes.
- Success metrics: 95th pct streaming latency < 450ms for 1-token increments; end-to-end tool-call roundtrip < 1200ms; semantic similarity QA >= 0.82 on the curated eval set.
- Timeline: 2-week sandbox activation (dev + infra prov.), 2-week evaluation (stress + quality), then handoff to Dedicated if green.
- Ownership: Redwood SDK integration is owned by Marissa (technical lead), Redwood infra by Ben, Orion dev lead to be nominated.

I've attached a one-page scope and an SDK route map with recommended endpoints for the sandbox (attachment: orion-sandbox-poc-scope.pdf; sdk-route-map.png). Next steps I propose:

1) Ahmed to confirm the Orion dev lead and provide a short-lived test API key for tool-call endpoints (we can accept token or signed JWT).
2) Marissa to open a small PR with the example connector (we'll base on our streaming SDK sample).
3) We sync on Thursday to lock the evaluation set and exact measurement scripts.

If that aligns, I'll create the HubSpot playbook entry and a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Thanks — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Orion sandbox — post-demo recap and connector stitch proposal

Thanks Sean — this is helpful and captures the ask. A couple clarifications before we lock timeline: 

- Dev lead: I'll assign Javier (javier.perez@orion.ai) and loop him into the sandbox test key.
- Tool-call auth: we can provide a short-lived bearer token for the sandbox; production will use mTLS.
- Evaluation set: we want to include 120 targeted prompts covering entity resolution, multi-turn context, and numeric-extraction cases. I'll drop the list in the Drive folder by Tuesday EOD.

Two asks from our side: can you include a small script that simulates the 1M token/day load (burst pattern) and a simple dashboard definition (Grafana) so our SRE can validate latency SLOs quickly?

If those are doable we can start on Wednesday.

Ahmed

Subject: Re: Orion sandbox — post-demo recap and connector stitch proposal

Ahmed — good call. We'll provide three deliverables for the sandbox activation:

1) Example connector repo + PR (streaming SDK sample using our continuous-batching wiring) — Marissa to own.
2) Load generator script (python + k6 example) and a Terraform snippet for ephemeral infra — Evelyn to own.
3) Grafana dashboard templates + measurement queries for 95/99 pct latency and token throughput — Ben to own.

Router/SDK endpoints we'll surface in the example PR:
- POST /v1/stream (chunked streaming, SSE fallback)
- POST /v1/completions?model=redwood-sandbox-v1 (server-side streaming preferred)
- POST /v1/toolcall/webhook (signed header HMAC)

I'll attach a lightweight checklist in the Drive and kick off the repo tonight. Expected ETA for the PR and scripts: 48 hours.

Marissa
